encrypt_crypten_module: encrypt a CrypTen nn.Module to convert parameters into CrypTensors for secure MPC inference
build_sequential_model: build a CrypTen Sequential model by chaining Linear, Conv2d, and ReLU modules together
create_linear_layer: create a CrypTen Linear layer with specified in_features and out_features for encrypted matrix multiplication
create_conv2d_layer: create a CrypTen Conv2d layer with configurable kernel_size, stride, padding, and groups
save_load_state_dict: save a CrypTen module state to a state_dict or load parameters from a checkpoint state_dict
